title: An affine etale lattice neighborhood at each point
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite-dimensional normed field extension of Q_ell, X any scheme, and P an internal rational continuous module with a pro-etale finite free trivializing cover. For each point x of X there exist an affine scheme U, an etale map p:U→X whose image contains x, and an internal integral module M on U with a pro-etale finite free trivializing cover and an isomorphism from its ordinary scalar extension to canonical p*P. Coefficients are those of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. The ranks may vary and may be zero. No finite simultaneous choice or assembly on a disjoint union is asserted.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), followed by affine refinement as in the first paragraph of Lemma 6.8.13

proof.text: Encode P by the actual rational equivalence. The compatibility theorem gives finite local freeness. Apply the existing exists_lisse_lattice_etale_local to get an etale covering with specified integral sectionwise lattices. At the terminal object of the etale site, the covering sieve contains an etale scheme cover; choose a point above x in that cover and factor its arrow through a member of the supplied family.

Apply the second clause of the compatibility theorem to that member and its given integral lattice. Its inverse integral encoding is a locally finite free internal module with the required rationalization. This is an explicit inverse-equivalence construction, not an arbitrary existence witness.

Choose an affine open neighborhood of the chosen point. Pull back the integral module and its trivializing scheme cover. A strong monoidal additive pullback preserves finite biproducts of the regular module; restriction along invertible coefficient maps preserves freeness. Bind the pulled-back covers and use the raw mapMod composition comparison to establish the exact locally-free predicate. The existing pullIso and upperStarComp identify its rationalization with the composite pullback of P. Reuse the shared ContinuousLocallyFreePullback API instead of redeclaring its helpers.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousLisse_affine_etale_lattice
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P)) (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (p : U ⟶ X), IsAffine U ∧ Etale p ∧ x ∈ Set.range p ∧
    ∃ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U),
      (∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : D.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M)) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) U)).obj M ≅
        (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P)
